methodology.scope: Read-only audit of supplied captures and repository product records; no app/Figma edits and no live prototype testing.
methodology.authority: Explicit approved decisions supersede conflicting older prose; newer frame IDs are never authority by themselves.
methodology.edgeIndices: Zero-based positions in connection-map.edges, bound to source.edgesSha256. Cosmetic/register metadata changes do not alter this edge evidence.
methodology.entryExitMeaning: entryIds/exitIds are curated flow reference points, not claims of graph roots/terminals. observedEntryIds/observedExitTargetIds are actual cross-family boundaries, including global navigation and conditional/hidden references.
methodology.reachability: Conservative possible reachability follows all target edges, including hidden controls and all mutually exclusive branches. It does not execute variables, determine feasible user paths, discover unrecorded starting points, or establish app reachability.
methodology.status: Every screen retains design identity and explicit uncertainty. Visual/app verification is maintained separately in visual-review.json and source-mapping.json; not advanced by graph analysis.

families.name: Shared creation and people overlays
families.actor: Signed-in organizer choosing an action or people
families.intendedSemantics: Open a contextual create menu or people selector; dismiss without committing a financial or membership operation.
families.canonicalDecision: Overlay closed/open/closing and tap-catch states are intentional animation and dismissal machinery, not separate application destinations.

families.name: Authentication and recovery
families.actor: Account owner or unauthenticated recipient
families.intendedSemantics: Authenticate, recover access and restore the intended destination. Bank connection is optional for organization after sign-in.
families.canonicalDecision: October 7 contextual banking and October 5 account-required entry supersede blanket bank gates and guest-first continuation entry. Recovery generations remain preserved; do not select solely by age.

families.name: Account settings and public profiles
families.actor: Account owner; permitted public-profile viewer
families.intendedSemantics: Manage private account settings separately from public identity and illustrative reputation.
families.canonicalDecision: Profile reputation numbers are illustrative; scoring policy is unresolved. Continuation names may not match current visible persona.

families.name: Circle organization, invitations and administration
families.actor: Circle Host, accepted member, invited recipient, proposed successor
families.intendedSemantics: Organize a consent-based group; invite, accept, leave or hand over Circle administration independently of Card and Bill roles.
families.canonicalDecision: Circle membership never grants contribution obligations or credentials. Anonymous visibility and actor-specific administration follow product rules, not shared fixture identity.

families.name: Card collection, detail and settings
families.actor: Card Host or independently approved Trusted Spender
families.intendedSemantics: Show the user’s permitted Card setup, credential, activity and controls according to resource role.
families.canonicalDecision: Grocery/Trip are documented spender fixtures; Family/Apartment are host fixtures. The mixed-role collection is intentional and must not be generalized into identical privileges.

families.name: Card setup creation
families.actor: Prospective Card Host
families.intendedSemantics: Create an unissued setup shell through details, appearance, optional Circle and review, then fulfill activation prerequisites separately.
families.canonicalDecision: Approved October 6 recovery source IDs. Creation does not prove issuance, funds, consent or automatic invitation delivery.

families.name: Spender invitations, permissions and card-access states
families.actor: Card Host; adult Trusted Spender; reviewer switching illustrative actors
families.intendedSemantics: Invite and review separate spending access; provider checks precede assigned credentials, while pause/remove affects only spending rights.
families.canonicalDecision: Provider outcomes include standalone review scenarios by design. Review index is not user navigation. Managed-minor onboarding is not supplied by the adult role examples.

families.name: Card balance and funding
families.actor: Card Host or separately eligible funding actor
families.intendedSemantics: Review source, amount and timing; confirm once, then show pending until provider settlement.
families.canonicalDecision: Spender-only access must not expose host pool balances, Bill reserves or funding controls. Financial values and completion require real provider evidence in an app.

families.name: Goal planning and proposed terms
families.actor: Goal planner and future individually consenting contributors
families.intendedSemantics: Prepare a target/time-based Goal, Circle, proposed people/shares, schedule and Card; distinguish saved planning from accepted agreements or locked funds.
families.canonicalDecision: October 7 intends Goals with Bills/Circles and defers relocation. Current app scope is host-owned draft planning; the finished-design proposal is not authorization to collect.

families.name: Bill collection and role-specific details
families.actor: Bill Host or contributor with resource access
families.intendedSemantics: Organize All bills and Shared, inspect the permitted Bill and personal contribution, and enter explicit review/management flows.
families.canonicalDecision: All bills left; Shared right/default. Manual planning is available without bank setup. Older reversed ordering and blanket gates are explicitly superseded.

families.name: Bill creation, import and connection
families.actor: Bill Host organizing manual Bills or confirming provider suggestions
families.intendedSemantics: Enter identity/schedule and eligible people/allocation, choose connections, review proposals; explicitly confirm imported suggestions into All bills.
families.canonicalDecision: Manual self-only planning may remain unconnected and skip allocation. Import requires bank evidence. Connecting a Circle/Card does not enroll contributors or grant spending rights.

families.name: Contributor agreement review and acceptance
families.actor: Invited Bill contributor
families.intendedSemantics: Review exact personal terms, choose manual/automatic method and own account, accept or decline independently.
families.canonicalDecision: Manual acceptance is not debit authorization or settlement. Automatic contributions require exact accepted terms and funding authorization.

families.name: Bill payment, changed-share review and recovery
families.actor: Contributor resolving their own payment or proposed agreement change
families.intendedSemantics: Review a contribution, distinguish pending/received/failed, reconnect securely, and accept/decline changed terms without silently raising caps.
families.canonicalDecision: Received is deliberately a separate settled-state example, with no timed auto-settlement link. Above-cap default means no contribution, not a partial debit.

families.name: Host allocation, proposals and declined-share resolution
families.actor: Bill Host proposing changes; each affected contributor independently decides
families.intendedSemantics: Allocate the full proposal, explain changes, inspect responses and resolve declines/removals without silently altering accepted terms.
families.canonicalDecision: Three/twelve-person and dollar/percentage/equal fixtures are purpose-specific variants. New proposals do not override accepted agreements before consent.

families.name: Agreement management, future contribution cancellation and Bill ending
families.actor: Contributor managing own agreement; Bill Host ending future collection
families.intendedSemantics: Maintain accepted/current/scheduled agreement states, change own funding, stop future authorization or end a Bill while retaining history and unresolved obligations.
families.canonicalDecision: Ending fixture explicitly assumes no pending transfers/funds. It does not cancel a merchant service, close a Card, remove Circle membership or erase obligations.

families.name: Splitfinder introduction and category entry
families.actor: Signed-in discovery user in current combined app
families.intendedSemantics: Choose Plans, Memberships, Subscriptions or Spaces and reach appropriate opportunities without a separate mandatory preference gate.
families.canonicalDecision: Four-category semantics are documented; older welcome/three-category routing is superseded. Guest-entry timing is superseded by account-required combined-app policy. Exact canonical frame choice remains unresolved.

families.name: Splitfinder browsing, search, filters and saved opportunities
families.actor: Discovery user
families.intendedSemantics: Find suitable opportunities through category-aware search, filtering and return paths; preserve selected criteria.
families.canonicalDecision: Service directory and generic/logo treatments coexist; do not infer brand permission or canonical visual selection. Map is deliberately unwired pending actual map design. Experience scope remains distinct from approved core launch decisions.

families.name: Listing detail, eligibility and sharing rules
families.actor: Prospective requester and listing organizer
families.intendedSemantics: Understand price, availability, eligibility and organizer before contacting; public estimates are not contribution agreements.
families.canonicalDecision: Savings baseline is total shared bill minus personal share per September 24. Joining a listing is separate from Circle membership and funding consent; service eligibility is not proven by acknowledgment.

families.name: Listing drafting, publication and management
families.actor: Listing organizer
families.intendedSemantics: Compose, review authority/accuracy, retain drafts on failure, publish and manage listings without automatic financial enrollment.
families.canonicalDecision: Circle-named listing branding must not imply accepted membership. Category chooser for generic custom service is distinct from optional Change category on a known category. Publication uses explicit checks; fixture states are not real moderation or persistence.

families.name: Residential discovery, inquiries and property posting
families.actor: Residential poster; interested prospective roommate
families.intendedSemantics: Create one to three individually searchable alternatives; verify poster at Publish and allow inquiries without discovery ID verification.
families.canonicalDecision: Inquiry opens conversation directly. Verification operations, share denominator, mandatory-date and exact-address visibility remain unresolved; numeric examples cannot settle them.

families.name: Listing requests, acceptance, withdrawal and outcomes
families.actor: Prospective requester; listing organizer reviewing requests
families.intendedSemantics: Submit introduction, review request, accept to open conversation, decline or withdraw without reserving a spot or creating Circle membership.
families.canonicalDecision: October 4 explicitly separates accepted requests from Circle membership, agreements and Card access. Recipient outcomes may require independently initiated actor/provider events rather than a local forward edge.

families.name: Inbox, direct/Circle/listing conversations and message actions
families.actor: Permitted direct, Circle or listing conversation participant
families.intendedSemantics: Keep Messages, Splitfinder inquiries and Invites distinct; send/retry messages with listing context and privacy appropriate to the channel.
families.canonicalDecision: A listing conversation does not create membership. Hidden message-action overlay states and tap-catch nodes are interaction states, not duplicate conversations.

families.name: Reporting, blocking, support and account closure
families.actor: Account owner or affected conversation participant
families.intendedSemantics: Report or block safely, obtain help, inspect terms, and request deletion without implying immediate erasure of retained records or unresolved obligations.
families.canonicalDecision: Blocking must not remove cancellation or existing agreement access. Figma legal/support/deletion copy is illustrative; no operational/compliance status is established.

families.name: Initial and delayed loading states
families.actor: Signed-in user awaiting resource data
families.intendedSemantics: Keep shell stable; blank content initially and minimal feedback only after 500 ms, preserving recoverable errors and same-resource refresh content.
families.canonicalDecision: These are response-state fixtures, not a prototype timer contract. No incoming navigation is required to demonstrate initial/delayed state. Runtime timing remains unverified here.

families.name: Explicitly preserved visual/reference alternatives
families.actor: Designer or reviewer, not an application actor
families.intendedSemantics: Preserve prior art and compare alternatives without treating reference artwork as an application route.
families.canonicalDecision: Prior role layouts are explicitly preserved references. The large continuation guide 2034:44493 is separately inventoried outside these 809 phone/state records and remains unread at full scale.
